barrier_rule: Ready service own barrier and authenticated issuer/principal/known-original scope/epoch/finite-rights/dependency/source model reports precede ledger/spawn reports. Policy/service window gates remain separate from worker gates.
claim_rule: Authenticated known-original model prefix reaches one claim before any worker preflight or requested binding observation. Failed/unknown attempted claim cannot return known-unused or dispatch.
closure_rule: Every positive source phase requires dependency/source views identical to the authenticated prefix; authentication also retains the original issuer-policy view. No closure refresh or substitution.
copy_rule: Same immutable prefix can be evaluated twice with equal output. No process is launched; copying/resetting input is outside a linear trace and proves no cross-process/global at-most-once property.
dependency_loading_rule: Caller must SHA-pin unchanged340 source and register it under this private alias; reducer performs no file loading or operational dispatch.
handoff_rule: Known worker ownership and bounded isolated handoff readiness required before releasing model prefix to worker bootstrap; missing/unknown handoff stops and preserves possible/known child obligations.
input_state: AdmissionState wrapping the unchanged340 CoreState plus immutable policy/consumed/spent view identities and three attempted bits plus original issuer/dependency/source view identities
launch_rule: One model launch attempt follows consumed context, and reported durable spend plus same-context stored output view precedes one spawn attempt. No transition refunds/resets/retries unknown spend or spawn.
model_reports: Closed immutable tri-state reported-valid/reported-invalid/unobserved assumptions plus all nine original rights reports and child-set report; never native evidence.
raw_status_rule: Append exact unique-call signed/unknown raw statuses; sticky first_failure is set once and never overwritten. Exit zero alone never proves success.
shape_vs_semantics: Only341 reachable four-phase wrapper states are admitted. This is prefix semantics over assumed reports, not authenticity, native irreversibility or all-writer/durability/launch proof.
